title: Fault Qualification
text: 故障确认算法，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Qualification time (s)} 指定错误确认时间、{Disqualification time (s)} 指定错误取消确认时间，按实例取值。

ports.name: Symptom
ports.summary: 征兆标志 0 | 1 | vector of 0 or 1 values

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: 错误标志 0 | 1 | vector of 0 or 1 values

params.name: Qualification time (s)
params.values: 错误确认时间 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Disqualification time (s)
params.values: 错误取消确认时间 4 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive integer
